title: 'Tempal: Item no Chikara' Unveils Additional Cast, Third Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Saenal Park and Team Argo 's Tempal: Item no Chikara ( Overgeared ) webtoon unveiled a pair of additional cast, third key visual (pictured), and third promotional video on Saturday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 2 at 11:30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kei Urana's Gachiakuta Manga Continues Hiatus
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine commented on September 8 on the ongoing hiatus of Kei Urana 's Gachiakuta manga. Kodansha stated it will announce the manga's return once it is decided.
author: ANN

title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power Manga Ends in Next Volume
content: Manga artist Yona Etou announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Disgraced No Longer, I'm Finding Happiness with the Prince! ( Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyō mo Muishiki ni Chikara o Tarenagasu: Kōshaku-ke no Ochikobore Reijō, Tōgisaki de Shiawase o Tsukamitoru!
author: ANN

title: 7 Critically Acclaimed Anime Crunchyroll Removed & You Can’t Stream Anywhere Else
content: Crunchyroll is the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, home to over a thousand series and movies. Each year, the platform adds a few dozen new releases to make them more accessible for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: The Record of a Fallen Vampire Manga Gets New Series After 19 Years, Teases Announcement
content: The October issue of Square Enix 's Shonen Gangan magazine announced on Thursday that Kyo Shirodaira and Yuri Kimura 's The Record of a Fallen Vampire manga will receive a new series titled Vampire Jūjikai: Inu ni wa Inu no Uta ( The Record of a Fallen Vampire : A Dog's Song for Dogs) in the magazine's next issue on…
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Returns With a Surprise New Crossover Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 still hasn’t shared a release window, but fans are more excited for the anime than ever. It’s going to be the best anime season so far thanks to the thrilling fights in the Culling Game as well as the several plot twists that happened in between .
author: ComicBook

title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Manga to End in 12th Volume Next Spring
content: Mika Yamamori announced in the author's notes from the 11th In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga volume on Friday that the series will end in next volume next spring. The wraparound jacket band on 11th volume also announced that the series has reached 8.2 million copies in circulation globally.
author: ANN

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Assembles You and Idol Precure, Wonderful Precure! in 2 Trailers
content: The staff for Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — presented the latest two trailers and a new still on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Orb, 100 Meters Manga Creator Uoto to Launch 2 New Manga Series
content: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth artist Uoto announced two new manga series on Friday and Saturday. Hallucination Meat will launch in Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine. The launch date is still to be determined, but Uoto thinks it will be this year.
author: ANN

title: Boruto Is Finally Returning From Hiatus With a Major Twist No One Expected
content: Boruto is returning with a new installment in the upcoming issue of V Jump after taking a break last month to celebrate the third anniversary of the series. In August 2026, the series turned three years old, and to mark its third anniversary, it took a break instead of having a grand celebration.
author: ComicBook
